logs_retention: History is kept locally for up to {0} days and {1} MB. Older files are removed first. Reduced limits apply on the next log write or export. The preview shows the latest 15 entries.
logs_write_failed: Logs could not be saved. Recent entries are still visible, but history may be incomplete.
cleanup_restart_photos: Google Photos navigation failed. Restarting the app and retrying once…
cleanup_wait_page: Google Photos is still changing pages. Waiting and reading again…
cleanup_home_failed: Space was freed, but Google Photos could not return to its library.
cleanup_stage_home: Returning to the Google Photos library…
cleanup_stage_confirm: Checking which backed-up copies can be freed…
cleanup_stage_release: Google Photos is freeing backed-up device copies…
cleanup_stage_percent: Google Photos is freeing device space · {0}%
cleanup_stage_verify: Verifying cleanup results and available space…
device_setup_prompt: Connect Pixel to start a second backup
backup_description: Send Apple Photos originals to Pixel, then back them up with Google Photos.
photos_permission_help: Allow PixelBridge in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Photos.
error_tools_download: Google’s download service returned an error. Please try again later.
error_tools_validation: The downloaded connection tools could not be verified.
error_tools_existing: The tools folder already exists. Select the existing installation.
backup_another_instance: Another PixelBridge instance is backing up. Wait for it to finish.
error_photos_permission: Allow access to Apple Photos first.
error_setup_required: Install connection tools and select a Pixel first.
batch_empty: No new items in this batch. Automatic backup will check again in {0} minutes.
error_pixel_generation: Transfer stopped: this device is not a first-generation Pixel. Select a supported Pixel or Pixel XL.
error_pixel_temperature: Pixel is too warm. Keep it ventilated and let it cool below {0}°C. Automatic backup will check again next round.
error_pixel_storage: Pixel is low on storage. Confirm backup in Google Photos before freeing space on the phone. Your progress is retained.
error_pixel_disconnected: Pixel disconnected. Check the cable and allow USB debugging on the phone, then reconnect to continue.
error_cache_budget: The local cache budget of {0} GB is insufficient. Completed files verified on Pixel can be reclaimed; other files are retained. Check automatic cleanup or increase the budget for this item.
error_mac_storage: Not enough free space. At least {0} GB must remain available on the Mac.
error_asset_missing: This item is no longer in the photo library.
error_original_missing: The unmodified original could not be found.
error_format_unsupported: This original format ({0}) is not supported yet. The item remains in the retry queue.
error_cache_corrupt: The prepared file failed verification. Its cache was isolated; the original will be downloaded again on retry.
error_motion_missing: The motion photo has no paired video. A still replacement was not uploaded.
error_hash_unavailable: The file checksum could not be obtained.
error_transfer_verification: Pixel transfer verification returned incomplete results.
log_cache_retained: Transfer completed; Mac cache retained for now: {0}
log_cache_batch_reclaimed: Reclaimed {0} Mac cache items ({1}). Pixel files were retained.
backup_footer_summary: {0} items sent to Pixel · Google Photos handles cloud upload
gallery_intro: Connect Apple Photos and keep another copy of your memories.
photos_connect_description: Allow photo access to see your library here.
gallery_loading_description: Your photos will appear once the library is ready.
gallery_empty_description: New photos appear automatically after syncing to the system photo library.
overview_heading: A second home for your memories
overview_description: Keep Apple Photos as it is. Send another copy through Pixel.
cache_cleanup_enabled: Mac transfer cache is reclaimed after file verification.
cache_cleanup_disabled: Automatic Mac cache cleanup is off.
backup_cloud_notice: Transferred does not mean backed up to the cloud. Check upload status in Google Photos.
setup_photos_description: Allow access to originals to prepare your second backup.
setup_pixel_description: Connect your phone with a data cable and allow USB debugging.
tasks_empty_description: Start a backup to see each file’s progress here.
tasks_cloud_notice: “Sent to Pixel” confirms matching files. Google Photos cloud status is not automatically verified.
device_description: Transfer originals over USB. Google Photos on the phone handles cloud backup.
adb_description: Install Google’s official connection tools to transfer photos.
setup_cable_description: Use a USB cable that supports data transfer between Pixel and Mac.
setup_debug_description: Enable USB debugging in Pixel’s developer options.
setup_authorize_description: Unlock the phone and allow the debugging connection.
setup_cloud_description: Stay signed in, keep a network connection, and check the phone’s backup settings.
settings_description: Changes are saved automatically. Adjust storage and scheduling to your needs.
settings_locked: A file is being processed. Pause backup and wait for it to finish before changing runtime settings.
settings_login_description: PixelBridge stays in the menu bar after you close its window.
settings_interval_description: Start the next check at this interval in automatic mode.
settings_batch_description: In automatic mode, the next batch is scheduled after each round.
settings_resume_notice: Quitting stops tasks. On the next launch, the queue is retained and enabled automatic mode resumes.
settings_reclaim_description: Remove Mac transfer files after Pixel verification and progress are saved.
settings_reclaim_notice: Apple Photos originals and Pixel files are retained. Reclaiming cache does not confirm cloud backup.
settings_protection_notice: Transfer pauses at storage or temperature limits. Automatic mode checks again later. Pixel also reserves room for the current file.
settings_capabilities: Back up unmodified originals and package motion photos as single files. Edited versions, album structure, automatic cloud verification and Pixel cleanup are not available yet.
app_tagline: · Another copy of your Apple Photos
adb_sheet_description: Download Android Platform Tools from Google into PixelBridge’s tools folder. Android Studio and administrator access are not required.
adb_consent: Installing means you agree to these terms. If the download fails, retry or select an existing adb installation.
error_timeout: Operation timed out. It will retry next round.
error_download_budget: Original download stopped because the cache budget is insufficient. Increase the limit or free disk space.
error_icloud_timeout: The iCloud download exceeded 15 minutes and was cancelled. Check your connection and retry.
error_lock_create: Unable to create the backup lock.
error_lock_acquire: Unable to lock the backup task ({0}).
language_description: Follow the system language or choose your preference.
batch_summary: Transferred {0} items this round; {1} waiting to retry. Google Photos handles cloud upload.
logs_original_language: Diagnostics retain their original language. System and tool messages are shown as received.
error_external: The operation could not complete. See the activity log for details.
photos_permission_usage: PixelBridge reads photo and motion-photo originals to back them up through your Google Pixel.
gallery_refresh_help: Check for new and changed photos. Backup progress is preserved.
gallery_labels_description: The gallery uses icons for media type and transfer status. Hover for details, or enable text labels.
updates_description: Free, open-source beta. Update packages are verified before installation.
updates_automatic_description: Notify when a new version is available. You choose when to install.
tasks_no_matches_description: Try another status or photo type.
tasks_size_help: Actual prepared file size, including the motion track. A dash means no size has been recorded; sizes are recorded when new tasks are prepared.
tasks_stage_progress_help: Stage progress: download, prepare, transfer, verify. This is not a byte-completion percentage.
settings_concurrency_description: Process up to 1–3 tasks at once; default 1. Original downloads and conversion stay sequential while Pixel transfers can overlap. Pause backup before changing this. This does not control Google Photos cloud uploads.
tasks_active_description: Marked as sent after file verification succeeds.
cleanup_description: Keep at least {0} GB free on Pixel. If the next transfer cannot meet this requirement, use Google Photos to free device space occupied by backed-up copies before continuing.
cleanup_scope_notice: Setup only inspects cleanup pages; it does not delete files. Compatibility follows recognized Chinese/English screens, not a fixed Google Photos version. Unrecognized screens stop the flow. Currently for original Pixel / Pixel XL on Android 10. Google Photos may also clean eligible backed-up files in other folders. Pausing PixelBridge does not stop cleanup already started in Google Photos.
cleanup_enabled: Enabled for the checked Pixel and Google Photos account.
cleanup_finished: Google Photos cleanup finished. Available space increased by {0}.
cleanup_unsupported: Requires an original Pixel / Pixel XL on Android 10 with Google Photos installed. No cleanup was started.
cleanup_locked: Unlock the Pixel before device cleanup can continue.
cleanup_page_unknown: Google Photos page could not be identified. No further buttons were pressed. Open its Photos page and try again.
cleanup_account_changed: The Pixel or Google Photos account differs from the one checked. Disable cleanup, then check and enable it again.
cleanup_waiting: Waiting for the Pixel connection or another operation to finish. No cleanup was started.
cleanup_nothing: Google Photos reports nothing to free up. New transfers remain stopped; PixelBridge will check again later.
cleanup_timeout: Cleanup completion is not yet confirmed. Transfers remain paused; the next check will only inspect the existing cleanup.
cleanup_pending: Previous cleanup needs attention. Open the Google Photos cleanup progress or completion page, then resume backup. No new cleanup was started.
cleanup_paused: PixelBridge is paused. Cleanup already started in Google Photos may continue.
cleanup_connection_failed: Could not read Pixel cleanup status. Check the connection. New transfers remain stopped.
cleanup_cooldown: Waiting before the next cleanup attempt (up to 10 minutes).
experiments_description: Try features we’re still refining. Enable each one independently and turn it off at any time.
experiments_pause_notice: Pause backup and wait for the current operation to finish before checking or changing this feature.
cleanup_holding: Waiting for Pixel space cleanup. New transfers are stopped; cleanup is checked first after a pause or restart.
cleanup_draining: Stopping concurrent transfers before checking Pixel space and cleanup.
cleanup_foreground: Open Google Photos or the launcher on the Pixel. Another app is in the foreground; new transfers remain stopped.
cleanup_backup_wait: Waiting for Google Photos to finish its current uploads. New transfers remain stopped.
cleanup_retry_after: Waiting after the previous cleanup action: about {0} minute(s) left. New transfers remain stopped.
cleanup_check_space: Checking automatic cleanup: Pixel has {0} available; resuming transfers requires at least {1}, including the space reserve and pending files.
cleanup_temperature: Pixel temperature is {0}°C. Waiting for {1}°C or below; transfers and cleanup remain stopped.
cleanup_action_started: About to press Google Photos’ Free up space on this device. New transfers remain stopped until cleanup is confirmed.
cleanup_reconciled: The previous cleanup operation has ended. Checking available space; no new cleanup was started.
cleanup_space_low: Cleanup has ended, but only {0} is available. Resuming transfers requires at least {1}; waiting for more space.
cleanup_space_restored: Pixel available space has recovered to {0}. Transfers can continue.
settings_pixel_reserve_description: Transfers and automatic cleanup share this setting. Space for pending files and concurrent transfers is reserved before sending; transfers stop if it cannot be met.
